snippet.title: Under New Management: Approved for Testing
snippet.description:
Four all-new Cogs are rolling off the production line at Cogs, Inc. Together, they'll be just the corporate shake-up needed to take down Toontown.

Before a wider release, the Cogs are planning extensive market analysis and observation. To learn how YOU can participate in the public playtest of Under New Management, head over to toon.town/newcogs!
